import json
with open('evaluations.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Average scores for replicates of the "core" recipe
# The structure: pea protein ~0.20, TVP 0.18, binding ~0.27, methylcell 0.03, flavours 0.05, pepper+smoke 0.04
# Varying oil blend

print("All with binding~0.27, pep ~0.20, TVP 0.18:")
for d in data:
    r = {x['ingredient']: x['fraction'] for x in d['recipe']}
    if 0.26 <= r.get('binding components', 0) <= 0.28 and r.get('pea protein', 0) >= 0.19 and r.get('textured vegetable protein', 0) >= 0.17:
        co = r.get('coconut oil', 0)
        so = r.get('sunflower oil', 0)
        print(f"  iter {d['iteration']}: score={d['target_dissimilarity']:.3f}, coconut={co}, sunflower={so}, total_oil={co+so:.3f}")
"}
